headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, led by Michael Harris II's impressive performance at the plate. Harris II recorded 2 hits, including a home run, and drove in 2 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Victor Vodnik (Colorado Rockies) who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation. Other notable injuries include Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays) with a low back strain, and Lance McCullers Jr. (Houston Astros) with right shoulder inflammation.

The Tampa Bay Rays made a notable trade, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock. Additionally, the Los Angeles Dodgers acquired LHP Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Marlins 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, led by Michael Harris II's impressive performance at the plate. Harris II recorded 2 hits, including a home run, and drove in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Kevin Kelly earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players contributing to the win. JJ Bleday and Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense, while Alec Bohm and Brandon Marsh were among the Phillies' impact hitters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 5-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Gunnar Henderson and Shane Baz led the way for the Rays, while Pete Alonso and Samuel Basallo contributed for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rays Make Key Trade Addition**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays acquired 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. Dunn joins the Rays' roster in a significant move.
